attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Input1 is the exact original 65x67 card serving as sole visual authority for pose, lighting, crop, and occlusion; Input2 is the supplied mascot identity. Transform the human anatomy into a smooth golden-yellow compact round mascot head and body, featuring green-ringed black eyes and a simple closed mouth. Preserve the original hair, eyebrows as actual hair, and facial hair conditionally: maintain clean-shaven upper lip and chin with no moustache or beard, and keep pale/grey short side hair only where visible under the cap. Retain the green peaked cap with dark visor, broad gold band, and compact raised gold badge footprint. Keep the grey-green tunic with a closed dark high collar and small gold collar-tab footprints, preserving the source-visible shoulder and chest crop. Ensure a short broad chin-to-collar transition with raised/refitted original collar and shoulder line, front cloth in front/rear behind, and contact shadow. Avoid elongated yellow necks, funnels, clipping, floating collars, or cream bibs. Retain the whole dark tilted frame, opaque grey backing, and lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper short marks, keeping exact crop and occlusion. Ensure the entire backing, clothing, and subject are opaque, with genuine transparency only outside the complete card silhouette. Do not add readable text, figures, unseen awards, glasses, or unsupported cap details. Generate one asset, no comparison board.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: Stern bust facing IMAGE-LEFT in three-quarter view. Green peaked cap with dark visor, broad GOLD band and compact raised GOLD badge footprint. Pale/grey short side hair only where actually visible under cap; covered crown remains covered. Actual eyebrow HAIR; CLEAN-SHAVEN upper lip and chin, no moustache or beard. Grey-green tunic with CLOSED dark high collar and small gold collar-tab footprints; preserve source-visible shoulder/chest crop and the note occlusion. No spectacles or new awards.
The mascot reference supplies body identity only and must not erase source hair, cap or clothes. Retain the source stern closed-mouth expression. No external label, watermark or new backdrop.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
attempts.rejection_reason: Actually viewed exact unchanged small source, full returned original PNG, pair and white/cyan/alpha. Cap/visor with broad gold band and compact raised gold emblem area, source-visible pale short side hair, clean-shaven mouth/chin, left head direction, grey-green closed dark high-collar tunic, frame/opaque backing/note and exterior-only alpha are retained. Reject the anatomy/collar fit: yellow lower head narrows into an extended exposed neck shaft above the dark collar, without a compact rounded chin meeting a very short broad neckline. Raise/refit and broaden the source CLOSED dark collar and shoulder line to meet a near-round compact chin with coherent fabric overlap/contact shadow. Keep the actual closed tunic, white collar lining and small gold tabs, with no open jacket/shirt/tie substitution, long yellow neck, floating cloth, clipping or cream bib. Fine brow hairs beneath the low visor and emblem engraving are indistinct; they are not claimed as proven missing or used as the rejection reason. Opaque interiors/alpha are sound; separate exact-fullsize builtin repair needed for visible neck proportion.
